name: OneWeb
tagline: First-gen LEO broadband — 648 sats in 12 polar planes
description: First-generation LEO broadband constellation, 648 satellites at 1,200 km in 12 polar planes. Polar orbits give full pole-to-pole coverage that mid-inclination Starlink shells cannot reach. Acquired by Eutelsat in 2023 to form Eutelsat OneWeb; commercial service now bundled with Eutelsat GEO assets. Higher altitude than Starlink means slightly higher latency but fewer satellites needed.
best_known_for: First-gen LEO broadband — 648 sats in 12 polar planes
